title: My Love Story!!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Takeo Goda is a huge, kind-hearted high school boy whom girls overlook in favor of his handsome best friend Sunakawa. When Takeo rescues Rinko Yamato from a groper on a train, she falls for him, and the comedy follows the earnest, inexperienced couple through misunderstandings, a separation when her family moves to Spain, and a proposal before they start college together. Friendship with Sunakawa and the sweets Yamato bakes are running threads (Wikipedia; VIZ blurb; AniList Food, Slapstick).
life_message: Kindness and loyalty matter more than looks, and a good friend is worth as much as a sweetheart.

delivery.evidence: Kindness-over-looks theme carried by Takeo's actions and Sunakawa's loyalty in Wikipedia summary (to verify).

winners_losers: Kind, unglamorous Takeo wins Yamato's love; looks-based judgment loses. The story sympathizes with sincerity.
